name: codefriends
description: Steam Friends–style presence + DM popout for people using Cursor, Claude, Codex, and Gemini.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,popout -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @codefriends/server" "npm run dev -w @codefriends/popout"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @codefriends/shared && npm run build -w @codefriends/server && npm run build -w @codefriends/popout && npm run compile -w codefriends
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @codefriends/shared && npm run build -w @codefriends/server && npm run compile -w codefriends
